1. **[Splitting a change](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L128)** — PR description — Three independent concerns ship in one diff across three modules: the price-id offer-filter correction, a brand-new seat-capacity 409 on two endpoints, and narrowing `createCheckoutUrl`/`updateSubscription` from member to admin plus a new `ElevationGuard`. **Fix:** split along the seam and land them in order — (1) `fix: match the active plan price, not its display name` (`activePlanName` → `activePlanId`, `offersPlan()`, specs), (2) `feat: reject a plan with fewer Safe seats than the workspace uses`, (3) `fix!: require workspace admin to start or change a subscription` (`assertSpaceAdmin`, `ElevationGuard`, gated table). Same seam as [R-029](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L435).
2. **[Commit subject format](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L11)** — PR title — Two already-shipped endpoints stop serving non-admin members (200 becomes 403), but the title that becomes the permanent squash subject carries no `!` breaking-change marker. **Fix:** mark the authorization change breaking — `fix!: require workspace admin to start or change a subscription` — keeping the member-to-admin break explained in `## Summary`.
3. **[R-026: Redundant conditions and needless intermediates](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L402)** — [src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:442](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/ccc4841c0cef460308b92ad01570fc6b61db5444/src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts#L442) — `assertSafeSeatCapacity` parses the quota at line 434 only to test it for `null`, discards it, then `hasSeatCapacity` parses the same `metadata` a second time. **Fix:** keep the value it already has — `const quota = parseSafeSeatQuota(args.paymentLink.metadata, (message) => this.loggingService.warn(message)); if (quota === null) return; const used = await this.spaceSafesRepository.countBySpaceId(args.spaceId); if (used > quota) { throw new ConflictException(...); }` — and drop the then-unused `hasSeatCapacity` export and its spec block from `payment-link-offer.rules.ts`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 3 finding(s)
